visualReview.observation: Exhibition room and visitors; does not isolate a garment motif.

Garments displayed with archival portraits; context view, not calibrated fabric grid.

constructionStudyLeads.principle: Treat sleeve/inset/hem, neck/chest and cuff decoration as distinct placement fields.
constructionStudyLeads.evidence: Article interview with Yurii Melnychuk contrasts Poltava sleeve/inset/hem emphasis with neck/chest/cuff emphasis elsewhere.
constructionStudyLeads.status: attributed interview observation, not verified universal rule or source-image region assignment

constructionStudyLeads.principle: Retain fabric ground as part of colour and negative-space design.
constructionStudyLeads.evidence: Article discussion explicitly includes the white cloth ground.

constructionStudyLeads.principle: Keep period, garment use and locality attached to palette and placement observations.

excludedClaims: Embroidery does not shield thyroid glands from ionizing radiation; the interview claim is not accepted as medical or engineering evidence.
